Brewing tips for this blend

Highland Reserve shines with a medium-coarse grind. For pour-over, use a 1:16 coffee-to-water ratio at 200°F. Let it bloom for 30 seconds, then pour in slow concentric circles. Total brew time: 3:30–4:00 minutes. For French press, steep for 4 minutes and plunge slowly.
